method: Manual computer-use verification in native Chrome through accessibility state and screenshot; not a Playwright automated suite. Observations transcribed from returned UI state.
database: Temporary synthetic SQLite; working database unused.

cases.observation: Homepage loaded with search box, examples and 10/10 anonymous usage badge.
Synthetic admin login redirected to profile; expected email, name, admin link, password form and history controls displayed. Browser password-save prompt declined.
Admin page displayed user counts, catalog size, admin navigation and disabled self-revoke/suspend/delete controls.
Catalog rendered 11 synthetic/seed records; edit form exposed verified modality and URL fields; description change saved and appeared in the list.
Audit viewer displayed the catalog update with actor/target IDs, local timestamp and changed field names; description values and passwords were absent.
Plans page rendered Free 10/day, Pro unlimited and Enterprise unlimited with management controls.
Pricing rendered the same three plans and explicitly disclosed that billing is not wired.

Keyboard-submitted browser search completed with labelled rule-based fallback, domain/task/modality, heuristic score/privacy disclosures, catalog results and live Kaggle cards with source links. This validates fallback plus live retrieval, not Gemini availability.
Pointer click on Explore completed a second search and rendered catalog plus Kaggle cards.
Sign-out returned to login and removed the admin navigation.
Ordinary user login had no Admin link; direct /admin navigation redirected to homepage with 10/10 free quota.
Ordinary user /admin/audit displayed Admin access required without audit records.

limits: Password changes, reset delivery, delete confirmation/submission, mobile devices and cross-browser behavior were not exercised in UI; application route tests cover applicable security flows. Search used real providers with declared fallback, not a successful live Gemini understanding.
cleanup: Both synthetic sessions signed out; test tab closed and original browser tab restored; test servers stopped. No browser passwords saved.
warnings: Non-blocking THREE.Clock deprecation warning emitted by the 3D stack in dev logs.
